simple.prompt: Passive with modals: 'The confidential documents ___ under strict surveillance.'
simple.explanation: Modal passive: modal + be + V3 ('must be kept').

simple.prompt: Present Continuous Passive: 'The highway ___ due to emergency roadworks.'
simple.explanation: Present Continuous Passive: to be (is/are) + being + V3 ('is being repaired').

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif modal masa lalu 'should have been'.
simple.targetSentence: The client should have been notified earlier.
simple.explanation: Subject + should have been + past participle (notified) + earlier.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The client should have been'.

simple.prompt: Present Perfect Passive: 'Several unexpected vulnerabilities ___ in the new update.'
simple.explanation: Present Perfect Passive: have/has + been + V3 ('have been discovered').

simple.targetSentence: The suspect was being interrogated by detectives.
simple.explanation: Subject + was being interrogated + by detectives.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The suspect was being interrogated'.

simple.prompt: Future Passive: 'The newly constructed suspension bridge ___ next month.'
simple.explanation: Future Passive: will be + V3 ('will be inaugurated').
hints: Pasif masa depan: will be + V3.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif dengan dua objek.
simple.targetSentence: The scholarship was awarded to the top candidate.
simple.explanation: The scholarship (direct object) + was awarded to + the top candidate.
hints: Bentuk pasif: 'was awarded to the top candidate'.

simple.prompt: All confidential medical records must ___ stored inside the encrypted hospital vault.
simple.explanation: Modal passive dasar selalu mengikuti rumus: modal + be + V3 ('must be stored').
hints: Setelah modal 'must', verb to be tetap berbentuk dasar 'be'.

simple.prompt: Look at the courtyard — a new rainwater harvesting tank ___ being installed right now.
simple.explanation: Present Continuous Passive ('sedang dipasang sekarang') menggunakan pola 'is/are + being + V3'.

simple.prompt: Wait — the parcel can't be delivered today because the street ___ currently being resurfaced.
simple.explanation: Penanda 'currently' dan konteks hari ini meminta Present Continuous Passive ('is ... being resurfaced').
hints: Kata 'currently' menandakan masa kini sedang berjalan.

simple.prompt: All quarterly travel claims will have ___ processed before the holiday break.
simple.explanation: Future Perfect Passive ('akan sudah selesai diproses') menggunakan rumus 'will have been + V3'.
hints: Sudah ada 'will have' sebelum rumpang dan V3 'processed' sesudahnya.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang pembaruan sistem secara pasif.
dialogue: Have the security certificates been renewed yet?
Yes, every certificate ___ updated automatically early this morning.
simple.explanation: Kejadian pasif selesai pada waktu lampau spesifik ('early this morning') memakai Past Simple Passive ('was updated').

simple.prompt: Your library pass could ___ revoked if overdue fines remain unpaid for ninety days.
simple.explanation: Setelah modal 'could', bentuk pasif wajib memakai 'be' + V3 ('could be revoked').

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ganda hilangnya 'been' dalam kalimat Perfect Passive berikut.
simple.draft: Several faulty smoke alarms have already replaced across the third floor.
options: Several faulty smoke alarms have already been replaced across the third floor.
Several faulty smoke alarms have already being replaced across the third floor.
Several faulty smoke alarms were already been replaced across the third floor.
simple.explanation: Alarm tidak mengganti dirinya sendiri (pasif); Present Perfect Passive mewajibkan pola 'have/has + been + V3' ('have already been replaced').

simple.prompt: The draft blueprint is going ___ reviewed by the structural engineering panel tomorrow.
simple.explanation: Future passive dengan 'be going to' mengikuti pola 'is going to be + V3'.
hints: Lengkapkan konstruksi 'is going to + be + V3'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Modal Passive tentang kebijakan arsip.
simple.targetSentence: Archived tax invoices should be kept for at least seven years.
hints: Awali dengan 'Archived tax invoices should be kept'.
Tambahkan durasi 'for at least seven years'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Continuous Passive yang sedang berlangsung.
simple.targetSentence: The downtown tram tracks are being inspected by city engineers this week.
simple.explanation: 'Are being inspected' menyatakan proses inspeksi pasif yang sedang berjalan.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The downtown tram tracks are being inspected'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog passive reporting verbs (impersonal construction).
dialogue: What is the consensus regarding the merger?
It ___ that the acquisition will create thousands of jobs.
intermediate.explanation: Impersonal reporting passive: It + is/was + V3 (believed/reported/claimed) + that clause.
hints: Struktur impersonal: It is believed that...

intermediate.prompt: Personal reporting passive: 'The billionaire ___ to be negotiating the purchase of the football club.'
intermediate.explanation: Personal passive construction: Subject + is/are + V3 (rumored/thought/said) + to-infinitive.
hints: Subjek person + to be + V3 + to-infinitive.

intermediate.prompt: Causative passive: 'We need to ___ our financial statements audited by an independent firm.'
intermediate.explanation: Causative passive: have/get + something + V3 ('have our financial statements audited').
hints: Pola causative pasif: have + object + V3.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat personal passive dengan 'is said to be'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The ancient artifact is said to be cursed.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + is said to be + cursed (adjective/participle).
hints: Lanjutkan dengan 'is said to be cursed'.

intermediate.prompt: Prepositional passive verbs: 'The elderly gentleman was well ___ by his hospice nurses.'
intermediate.explanation: Phrasal verbs dalam bentuk pasif mempertahankan preposisinya: 'was well looked after by...'.
hints: Preposisi 'after' harus tetap menempel pada kata kerja.

intermediate.targetSentence: She got her passport renewed before the trip.
intermediate.explanation: Subject + got + her passport (object) + renewed (V3) + before the trip.
hints: Mulai dengan 'She got her passport renewed'.

dialogue: He is understood ___ the border under an assumed identity.
intermediate.explanation: Ketika peristiwa pasif merujuk pada aksi yang sudah terjadi di masa lampau sebelum waktu pelaporan, gunakan Perfect Infinitive ('to have crossed').
hints: Aksi melintasi perbatasan terjadi sebelum pelaporan.

intermediate.prompt: Notice the two-object passive focus: 'Our lead designer ___ a prestigious sustainability award at last night's gala.'
intermediate.explanation: Ketika penerima ('Our lead designer') menjadi subjek pasif dari 'present someone with something', gunakan 'was presented with + award'.
hints: Pola pasif 'present + sb + with + sth' → 'sb was presented with sth'.

intermediate.prompt: It ___ widely believed that early sleep deprivation impairs logical decision-making.
intermediate.explanation: Impersonal passive reporting untuk opini umum masa kini memakai 'It is widely believed / thought / reported that...'.
hints: Pola impersonal reporting umum: 'It is + adverb + V3 + that...'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang penekanan subjek orang dengan Personal Passive Reporting.
dialogue: How certain are historians about this ancient shipyard?
The port ___ to have served over two hundred merchant ships annually.
intermediate.explanation: Personal passive reporting mengangkat subjek spesifik ('The port') di depan diikuti 'is thought / is estimated + to have + V3' untuk aksi masa lalu.
hints: Struktur personal reporting pasif: Subject + is thought + to have V3.
Pelabuhan tidak 'berpikir' sendiri, melainkan 'diyakini oleh para ahli'.

intermediate.prompt: Those cracked safety helmets ought to ___ discarded weeks ago.
intermediate.explanation: Modal Perfect Passive ('seharusnya sudah dibuang minggu lalu') berpola: modal ('ought to' / 'should') + 'have been' + V3.
hints: Ada waktu lampau 'weeks ago' setelah 'ought to'.
Modal Perfect Passive memakai 'have been + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: Do you dislike ___ interrupted while presenting complex financial charts?
intermediate.explanation: Verb 'dislike' diikuti gerund (-ing); jika bermakna pasif ('disela oleh orang lain'), gunakan Passive Gerund: 'being + V3 (being interrupted)'.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan impersonal 'It' dengan to-infinitive reporting pasif berikut.
intermediate.draft: It is expected the new desalination plant to supply half the island's fresh water.
options: The new desalination plant is expected to supply half the island's fresh water.
It is expected to supply half the island's fresh water the new desalination plant.
The new desalination plant expected to supply half the island's fresh water.
intermediate.explanation: Ada dua konstruksi yang jangan dicampur: 1) Impersonal: 'It is expected THAT the plant will supply...'; 2) Personal: 'The new desalination plant is expected TO supply...'.
hints: Jangan mencampur 'It is expected' langsung dengan 'noun + to V1'.
Jadikan 'The new desalination plant' subjeknya sebelum 'is expected to supply'.

intermediate.prompt: Every single detail of the merger must have ___ leaked by an insider before the press release.
intermediate.explanation: Modal Perfect Passive deduksi lampau memakai 'must have been + V3'.

intermediate.prompt: We are getting the clinic's rooftop solar panels ___ before the dry season peaks.
intermediate.explanation: Causative passive ('get + Object + V3') menyatakan jasa yang dikerjakan oleh pihak lain pada barang milik kita.
hints: Panel surya dibersihkan oleh teknisi ('get + sth + V3').

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Impersonal Passive Reporting dengan 'It is estimated'.
intermediate.targetSentence: It is estimated that urban freight traffic will double within fifteen years.
intermediate.explanation: Struktur impersonal reporting: 'It is estimated that + full clause'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Passive Gerund setelah preposisi 'without'.
intermediate.targetSentence: The whistleblower submitted the audit report without being noticed by management.
intermediate.explanation: Preposisi 'without' + passive gerund ('being noticed') + agen 'by management'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The whistleblower submitted the audit report'.
Akhiri dengan 'without being noticed by management'.

complex.draft: There is reported that several passengers sustained minor injuries.
options: It is reported that several passengers sustained minor injuries.
Passengers are reported that they sustained minor injuries.
That several passengers sustained minor injuries is reporting.
complex.explanation: Impersonal passive reporting menggunakan dummy pronoun 'It' (bukan There): 'It is reported that...'.

complex.prompt: Choose the correct transformation for past events into personal passive: 'People believe that Socrates drank hemlock.'
options: Socrates is believed to have drunk hemlock.
Socrates is believed to drink hemlock.
Socrates was believed to drink hemlock.
complex.explanation: Karena aksi (minum racun) terjadi sebelum waktu keyakinan saat ini (present belief), wajib memakai Perfect Infinitive: 'is believed to have drunk'.
hints: Aksi masa lalu dilaporkan pada masa kini.

complex.prompt: Passive gerunds and infinitives: 'The diplomat objected to ___ as a junior representative.'
complex.explanation: Setelah preposisi 'to' pada 'object to', kata kerja harus berbentuk Gerund. Dalam konteks pasif: 'being treated'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat passive dengan perfect infinitive 'is alleged to have embezzled'.
complex.targetSentence: The former CFO is alleged to have embezzled company funds.
complex.explanation: Subject + is alleged + to have embezzled (perfect infinitive) + company funds.
hints: Mulai dengan 'The former CFO is alleged'.
Lanjutkan dengan 'to have embezzled company funds'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kata kerja intransitif yang keliru dipasifkan.
complex.draft: An unfortunate traffic collision was happened on the expressway.
options: An unfortunate traffic collision happened on the expressway.
An unfortunate traffic collision was occurred on the expressway.
An unfortunate traffic collision was being happened on the expressway.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja intransitif seperti 'happen', 'occur', 'appear', dan 'exist' TIDAK MEMILIKI objek langsung, sehingga sama sekali TIDAK BISA dipasifkan. Wajib aktif: 'happened'.
hints: Kata kerja intransitif tidak bisa dipasifkan.

complex.prompt: Subtle register analysis: Why do scientific and academic research papers heavily favor passive constructions?
options: To establish an objective tone by foregrounding the methodology and findings rather than the researcher's ego.
Because active voice is grammatically prohibited in all journals.
To make the text artificially longer.
complex.explanation: Gaya penulisan akademik ilmiah mengutamakan proses eksperimen, metodologi, dan data hasil temuan (objectivity), bukan pelaku peneliti.
hints: Tujuan objektivitas dan fokus pada metodologi/hasil.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog persidangan dengan bentuk pasif yuridis formal.
dialogue: What is the status of the seized evidence?
The encrypted hard drives are deemed ___ by state forensic analysts.
complex.explanation: Bentuk pasif ganda dengan perfect infinitive: 'to have been tampered with' (dianggap telah dirusak).
hints: Bukti telah dimanipulasi di masa lalu.

complex.prompt: Choose the personal passive reporting sentence that accurately shifts a PAST ongoing event into a passive perfect continuous infinitive.
options: The missing vessel is reported to have been drifting near the strait since Monday.
The missing vessel is reported to drifting near the strait since Monday.
It is reported the missing vessel to have been drifting since Monday.
complex.explanation: Saat sumber berita melaporkan sekarang ('is reported') suatu aktivitas yang telah berlangsung terus sejak Senin lalu hingga kini/baru saja, gunakan passive + perfect continuous infinitive ('to have been + V-ing').
hints: Pelaporan berlangsung sekarang ('is reported'), aktivitas berdurasi terjadi sejak Senin.
Pasangkan 'is reported to have been drifting'.

complex.prompt: In strict formal prose, prepositional verbs preserve their preposition at the end of a passive clause: 'Such reckless financial practices must not ___.'
complex.explanation: Phrasal/prepositional verb ('gloss over') wajib mempertahankan partikel 'over' dan memakai bentuk V3 ('glossed over') setelah modal passive 'must not be'.
hints: Pastikan 'be + V3' dan partikel 'over' tetap hadir.
Opsi B dan C tidak gramatikal.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan mempasifkan intransitive verb dan register informal pada kalimat akademik berikut.
complex.draft: During the simulation, a sudden voltage spike was emerged, so we got the data logger checked out.
options: During the simulation, a sudden voltage spike emerged, and the data logger was subsequently inspected.
During the simulation, a sudden voltage spike was emerged, and the data logger had inspected.
During the simulation, a sudden voltage spike was occurred, so the data logger was checked.
complex.explanation: 'Emerge' (sama seperti 'occur' dan 'appear') adalah intransitive verb yang tidak boleh dipasifkan ('was emerged' salah), dan 'got ... checked out' terlalu kasual untuk laporan akademik dibandingkan 'was subsequently inspected'.
hints: 'Emerge' tidak memiliki objek langsung sehingga tidak bisa pasif.
Gunakan bentuk aktif 'emerged' + pasif akademik formal 'was inspected'.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang pemakaian pasif untuk menjaga objektivitas laporan ilmiah.
dialogue: Why did you revise 'We heated the cobalt alloy to 800°C' to 'The cobalt alloy was heated to 800°C'?
In experimental methodology, passive voice removes personal pronouns to foreground ___.
options: the material and procedure rather than the researcher
informal conversational intimacy with the reader
complex.explanation: Dalam bagian Methods laporan ilmiah, kalimat pasif digunakan secara sengaja untuk menjaga nada objektif dan menempatkan objek penelitian/prosedur di fokus utama (thematic front-focus).
hints: Fokus metode ilmiah adalah bahan dan prosedur, bukan 'kami'.

complex.prompt: The ancient bronze compass is alleged ___ from the sunken merchant ship in 1984.
complex.explanation: Pelaporan kini ('is alleged') mengenai peristiwa PASIF yang sudah terjadi di masa lampau ('in 1984') wajib memakai Passive Perfect Infinitive: 'to have been + V3 (to have been recovered)'.
hints: Gabungan pasif + lampau setelah 'is alleged': 'to have been + V3'.

complex.prompt: Notice the subtle meaning of causative 'have/get' in adversity: 'Poor Dani ___ his bicycle stolen right outside the library!'
complex.explanation: Struktur 'have + object + V3' juga dipakai secara idiomatis untuk kemalangan/kejadian buruk tak terduga yang menimpa seseorang ('had his wallet/bicycle stolen').
hints: Bukan menyuruh mencuri, melainkan mengalami kejadian sial.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan menyatukan kata kerja pasif 'let' (mengizinkan) secara langsung dengan bare infinitive berikut.
complex.draft: External photographers were not let enter the sterile microchip cleanroom.
options: External photographers were not allowed to enter the sterile microchip cleanroom.
External photographers were not let entering the sterile microchip cleanroom.
External photographers did not let to enter the sterile microchip cleanroom.
complex.explanation: Kata kerja 'let' sangat jarang/tidak dipakai dalam bentuk pasif; ubah ke 'be allowed to + V1' ('were not allowed to enter').
hints: 'Let' hampir tidak memiliki bentuk pasif baku dalam bahasa Inggris modern.
Ganti 'were not let' dengan 'were not allowed to'.

complex.prompt: No participant appreciates ___ kept waiting past the scheduled start without an update.
complex.explanation: 'Appreciate' diikuti gerund; makna pasif 'dibiarkan menunggu' memakai Passive Gerund 'being kept waiting'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pelaporan pasif dengan Passive Perfect Infinitive.
complex.targetSentence: The medieval bridge is thought to have been reinforced during the seventeenth century.
complex.explanation: 'Is thought to have been + V3' menggabungkan opini sekarang tentang konstruksi pasif masa lalu.
hints: Awali dengan 'The medieval bridge is thought'.
Sambungkan dengan 'to have been reinforced during the seventeenth century'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pasif formal dengan prepositional verb yang mempertahankan preposisinya.
complex.targetSentence: Those outdated procurement rules should be done away with before the next fiscal year.
complex.explanation: 'Do away with' mempertahankan kedua partikel 'away with' tepat setelah V3 'done'.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Those outdated procurement rules should be'.
Pastikan 'done away with' utuh sebelum frasa waktu.
